title: Vendor Contract Renewal Conflict
core_conflict: A procurement summary says the vendor renewal is approved, while legal emails and calendar review windows show unresolved redlines and duplicate renewal paths.
required_constraints: include contradictory procurement, legal, and finance evidence about renewal readiness
include workspace files, email threads, task-board renewal blockers, and calendar approval deadlines
include dynamic updates that modify redline status or contract renewal authority after early rounds
emphasize multi-source reasoning, deadline reconciliation, and duplicate avoidance
